chunks: Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Abdillah Al-Mawsawi narrated to me from Abdillah [Ubaidillah] ibn Nahik, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from Al-Halabi,

he said: I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the Ziyarah of the grave of Al-Husayn (peace be upon him). He said, 'Once a year, for I dislike being well-known (or having one's identity widely known).'
ai.seo_question: Why did Imam Al-Sadiq recommend visiting Imam Husayn's grave only once a year?
ai.summary: Imam Al-Sadiq (a.s.) prescribed an annual minimum for visiting the shrine of Imam Al-Husayn (a.s.), grounding this recommendation in the principle of *al-shuhrah* (public prominence). In the Shia scholarly tradition, this reflects a balance between maintaining the ritual's spiritual significance and avoiding the ostentation or social recognition that might accompany overly frequent or public visits, thereby preserving humility and sincerity in devotion.
